I can't calculate embedded emissions for this shipment. CN code 7208 is not in the factor table, and the ruleset requires the good's CN code to be listed before any estimate. I have not estimated a value.

The table covers only these CN codes: 7201, 7206 10 00, 7207 11 90, and 7214 20 00. Even though China appears as a country for several of them, a default value cannot be applied to 7208 under this ruleset.

To proceed, you would need one of the following:

- **A default value for CN 7208 from China** added to the factor table, or
- **Confirmation that the good falls under one of the listed CN codes**, which would require a different product description. Note that 7208 covers flat-rolled products of iron or non-alloy steel, so the listed codes may not match it.

If you can confirm either of these, I will calculate the total for 5,000 t using the formula: SEE × quantity, rounded half-up to 2 decimal places.
